ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel base (estimated 92% coverage) with high-intensity foreground features (estimated 8% coverage) creating a high-contrast ratio of approximately 11.5:1 across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity clusters concentrated in the mid-right lobe (complex intersecting linear pattern) and lower-left lobe (singular horizontal mark); smaller high-intensity clusters concentrated along the distal trailing edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation; calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis with a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jaggedness along the trailing edge boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude most pronounced on distal lobe tips; edge exhibits a rough, irregular sawtooth topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge lobes follow a parabolic convex curve from the central notch to the tips; leading edge follows a smooth, broad convex trajectory tapering at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 20-25 small, circular high-contrast pixel clusters concentrated on the upper-distal lobe surfaces and sporadically within the central black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant intersecting white linear pixel arrays on the right lobe forming a grid-like pattern; multiple isolated horizontal and diagonal linear marks on the left lobe and lower-center area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring including a prominent geometric 'double-cross' or 'hashtag' pattern on the right lobe and widespread punctate depigmentation likely corresponding to bio-fouling or prior parasite attachment points.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique horizontal high-intensity stroke located on the lower-left leading edge boundary, isolated from other major scar clusters.
